findings.source_quote: “Always carrying around the death of Jesus Christ in our body so that the life of Jesus Christ might be manifested in our mortal flesh.”
findings.suggested_fix: “Tukiwa daima tunachukua katika mwili wetu mauti ya Yesu Kristo, ili uzima wa Yesu Kristo udhihirishwe katika miili yetu ipatayo kufa.”
findings.translation_quote: “Tukiwa tumeibeba daima mauti ya Yesu Kristo katika miili yetu, ili uzima wa Yesu Kristo udhihirishwe katika miili yetu ipatayo kufa.”

findings.source_quote: “Every spirit which confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God.”
findings.suggested_fix: “Kila roho inayokiri kwamba Yesu Kristo amekuja katika mwili hutoka kwa Mungu.”
findings.translation_quote: “Kila roho inayokiri kwamba Yesu Kristo amekuja katika mwili imetoka kwa Mungu.”

findings.source_quote: “the new, who has been created according to God”
findings.suggested_fix: “utu mpya, aliyeumbwa kwa mfano wa Mungu”
findings.translation_quote: “utu mpya, aliyeumbwa kwa jinsi ya Mungu”

findings.source_quote: “how they grow rich in understanding, in knowledge, and in wisdom”
findings.suggested_fix: “jinsi wanavyozidi kuwa matajiri katika ufahamu, maarifa na hekima”
findings.translation_quote: “jinsi wanavyozidi kuwa matajiri katika ufahamu, maarifa na hekima”

findings.source_quote: “as in a mirror and, beholding the Lord’s glory, let us be transformed into the same image”
findings.suggested_fix: “tukiunganisha uzuri wa uso wetu na Kristo kama katika kioo na, huku tukitazama utukufu wa Bwana, tubadilishwe tufanane na sura iyo hiyo”
findings.translation_quote: “tukiunganisha uzuri wa uso wetu na Kristo, kama katika kioo, na kulitazama utukufu wa Bwana, tubadilishwe tufanane na sura iyo hiyo”
